title: Workspace Project row lock
description: Caller-transactional exclusive Project row lock. The caller owns authorization, transaction ordering, and commit. nowait selects the existing busy-fail-fast lock behavior; false waits for the Project lock. A missing Project returns row_json null.

row_json.description: Null when the Project does not exist; otherwise a lossless text JSON object containing the full 43-column Project row with counters supplied by the typed Labeling capability.

waiting_mode_errors.description: Database lock and transaction errors propagate without translation.

x-native-capabilities.authorization_boundary: The caller retains authorization and surrounding workflow checks; this function does not inspect actors or decide permissions.

functions.name: lock_project_row
functions.transaction_semantics: Acquire FOR UPDATE on the Project in the caller's existing transaction and return the full row snapshot. nowait=true fails immediately on contention using the Workspace project_busy hint; false waits. The caller owns permission checks, autoflush behavior, identity-map refresh, and commit.

x-native-capabilities.transaction_boundary: The caller owns the surrounding transaction and commit.
